title: readiness.json: the overnight readiness page (contract 1.25.0, not stable)
description: Since 1.17.0 (each forecast's `quality` since 1.18.0; `control` since 1.19.0; `soak` since 1.25.0; each forecast's `claimed`, `coverage` and `claims` since 1.28.1). Written by `harness readiness --site <dir>` beside readiness.html on the reports site: one row per calendar night (UTC) for the last ten nights, newest first, from the Main to RC forecasts kept on the `main-preview` branch and Main to RC's workflow runs (github.json). Derived from Readiness in src/readiness/model.ts. The band is deliberately absent: while the review floor caps the score the row carries the Gate only. Advisory: never read by a verdict, the Gate or an exit code. Not stable: it may change in a minor release.

harness.description: The harness version that built the page.

control.description: Since 1.19.0: the release-size control chart (XmR) and the WIP limit on the PRs waiting on main. Absent from a readiness.json written before 1.19.0.

soak.description: Since 1.25.0: the soak toward 2.0 (src/readiness/soak.ts). A clean night is a clean, verified nightly A/A and a clean a-to-a2 on that night's Main to RC forecast; a night on which Main to RC skipped an already-judged pair pauses the count; anything else breaks it. Advisory: never an input to the Gate, a verdict, an engine level or an exit code. Absent on a page built before 1.25.0.

clean.description: Clean nights since the last broken one.

brokenOn.description: The newest broken night since the start, when there is one.

checks.description: One per check that 2.0 may make blocking (the policy family).

quietNights.description: Judged nights in a row, newest back to the soak's start, with no finding of this check on b.

eligible.description: Quiet for the target and its planted mutant caught.

github.description: What was read of the workflow history, or why it was not. For people: do not parse.

aa.description: Since 1.25.0: what was read of the nightly A/A history (noise-history.json), or why it was not. For people: do not parse.

state.description: judged: a forecast was kept that night. unchanged: Main to RC finished green and kept nothing (the pair was already judged); `since` names the forecast it repeats. not judged: it ran and failed or was cancelled. running: a run has not finished. not yet: tonight, before any run. did not run: no run that night. not known: nothing kept and the workflow history was not read.

forecasts.description: The forecasts kept that night, newest first; empty unless judged.

since.description: On an unchanged night: the newest forecast kept before it, whose verdict it repeats.

runs.description: Main to RC's workflow runs that night, newest first; empty when there were none or the history was not read.

baselineMoved.description: Production moved between this row and the row below it: the delta starts again.

note.description: One sentence for the row. For people: do not parse.

commit.description: The commit side b's images were built from, when they all agree; the one to branch a release from.

digests.description: Side b's image digests, by app.

gate.description: confidence.json's Gate, or the verdict in capitals for a forecast kept before the score.

claimed.description: Since 1.28.1: the kept report's differences a claim covers (the known side, its "Claimed differences"); null when its report.json could not be read.

coverage.description: Since 1.28.1: claimed / (claimed + unclaimed), to three decimals; null when either is not known or both are 0.

claims.description: Since 1.28.1: claims, known and gaps (src/readiness/claims.ts), read from the kept report.json; absent when it could not be read. Informing results are in neither side. Advisory.

firstClaimed.description: The first claimed difference's id: its row in report.html is #hunk-<id>.

firstUnclaimed.description: The first unclaimed difference's id: its row in report.html is #hunk-<id>.

owed.description: Claims owed: one draft per cause of the unclaimed differences (the report's "Claims owed").

hygiene.description: The report's claim hygiene; null when it ran without a claims file.

findings.description: Claims to look at twice: too broad (covers-many-hunks), broad with or without approval, stale (matched nothing), expired (past its lifetime).

scope.description: Cut at 120 characters; the report has it whole.

anchor.description: The report.html section that lists it.

anchors.description: The report.html sections for each side, the drafts and the hygiene; null where the kept report has no such section.

informing.description: Since 1.21.0: the kept report's informing results no claim covers (reported, never gates); null for a forecast kept before engine levels.

informingBy.description: Since 1.22.0: informing by engine (its artefact), e.g. the policy family's checks; absent when informing is null or 0.

delta.description: The index entry's delta (reports-index.schema.json); null for a forecast kept before 1.16.1.

quality.description: Since 1.18.0: Speed, Metrics and Tests for this forecast, as the A3 draws them under its Gate.

report.description: The kept report.html, relative to the site.
